==Overview==
Being one of the larger [[Aggeloi]], the Walking Chrysopolis is a massive foe to be tackled, as it has several abilities revolving around its large size.

The Walking Chrysopolis starts with '''Normal State''' with the following abilities:
*Bash the front with its front shield, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back. This ability will only be used when the controlled Operator is at its front.
*Leaps high in the air and slams, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Roars and deals continuous Physical damage to Operators around.
*Pulls in Operators at the front to itself, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Start stepping at a larger force, dealing Physical damage to Operators on the spots.

The Walking Chrysopolis can enter '''Bastion State''', where it will conduct a leaping slam (see above) that cannot be interrupted, and lands with its shields covering its front, and has the following abilities:
*Periodically emit grounded shockwaves that deals Æther damage.
*When Operators attempt to attack through its shield, they will get knocked back.
*Expose its weakpoint at the back; The Walking Chrysopolis conducts the following based on the weakpoint status, then return to Normal State:
**If the weakpoint is destroyed, deal 160 Stagger and the Walking Chrysopolis become immobile and takes more DMG for a short period
**If the weakpoint is not destroyed for too long, the Walking Chrysopolis conducts a 360-degree swipe that deals Physical damage

The Walking Chrysopolis also has the following abilities that is unrestrained by its states:
*Swipes the back with its legs, dealing Physical damage to the back in a big distance. This ability will only be used when the controlled Operator is at its back.
*Perform a hard step with both of its legs, dealing Physical damage. This ability will only be used when the controlled Operator is at its back.
